changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'graph' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetEdge') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [graph].[AssetEdge]( [ID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [IntersectTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [IntersectTypeUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [PredicateID] [int] NOT NULL, [PredicateUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [PredicateType] [int] NOT NULL, [Properties] [xml] NOT NULL, [State] [int] NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL ) AS EDGE;
ALTER TABLE [graph].[AssetEdge] ADD CONSTRAINT [EC_GraphAssetEdge] CONNECTION (graph.[AssetNode] To graph.[AssetNode]); END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_GraphAssetEdge') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_GraphAssetEdge] ON [graph].[AssetEdge] ( [UpdatedOn] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_GraphAssetEdge_From') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_GraphAssetEdge_From] ON [graph].[AssetEdge] ( $from_id, $to_id ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_GraphAssetEdge_Id') BEGIN CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_GraphAssetEdge_Id] ON [graph].[AssetEdge] ( $edge_id ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_GraphAssetEdge_To') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_GraphAssetEdge_To] ON [graph].[AssetEdge] ( $to_id, $from_id ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_GraphAssetEdge_Uid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_GraphAssetEdge_Uid] ON [graph].[AssetEdge] ( [Uid] ASC ) END
